corporate.cleanNames: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is a 1200 by 1550 pixel atlas of 15 cropped small text regions from website screenshots, arranged in EXACTLY three columns by five rows with large gray spaces between crops. Remove ALL letters, Chinese characters, numbers and text in EVERY one of the 15 crops. Replace their text pixels with the matching original pale background of their own crop. Preserve the exact size and coordinates of every crop, and the gray separator background. In the top-left narrow vertical crop, remove ALL vertical lettering including CHUN MILE and PARTICLE FIELD; reconstruct the pale blue granular particle-face illustration under the removed letters naturally. Other crops have plain pale ivory/gray/green backgrounds: clean them seamlessly. No words, no logos, no symbols, no invented elements anywhere. DO NOT rearrange or resize the atlas, keep exact aspect ratio. The cleaned crop patches will be composited into the original screenshots.
corporate.vertical: Precise object removal. Input is a narrow crop from a corporate website screenshot showing a blue-gray particle illustration. COMPLETELY REMOVE ALL vertical lettering on the right, including every letter of CHUN MILE / PARTICLE FIELD. Fill the lettering with a natural continuation of the pale blue background and gray-blue granular particle texture underneath. Preserve the rest of this exact particle illustration, colors, position and composition. Output just the clean illustration crop, same aspect ratio. Absolutely zero text, zero letters, zero symbols, zero watermarks, no faint residual lettering. This will be composited back into the same original screenshot.
